description: Revert to the most consistently high-performing configuration (Depth=8, Matrix LR=0.06, WD=0.1, Batch=128) which historically achieved the lowest val_bpb (~0.9905) and stable convergence, as the previous stabilization attempt (0.055 LR / 0.12 WD) yielded a slightly worse result (0.9902), indicating the model requires slightly more aggressive updates to fully converge within the 5-minute budget.
